headline: Issued certificates, tree removals, and orders of conditions for several properties
summary: The Commission approved tree removal requests, closed several public hearings, and issued Orders of Conditions for multiple properties including 58 West Street, 343 Dodge Street, 31 Haskell Street, and 22 Kittredge Street. It also continued hearings for 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue and 76 & 78 Paine Avenue, and approved expenditures and prior meeting minutes.
decisions: Issued a Complete Certificate of Compliance for 19 Temi Road, DEP File #5-1417, including perpetual conditions #37-40, 3-0.
Approved the tree removal request for 28 Whitehall Circle with standard conditions, 3-0.
Approved the tree removal request for 27 Whitehall Circle with standard conditions, 3-0.
Approved the tree removal request for 27 Crescent Avenue with standard conditions, 3-0.
Closed the hearing for 58 West Street, DEP File #5-1472, 3-0.
Closed the hearing for 343 Dodge Street, DEP File #5-1476, 3-0.
Closed the hearing for 31 Haskell Street, DEP File #5-1477, 3-0.
Continued the hearing for 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue, DEP File #5-1478, to October 6, 2026, 3-0.
Closed the hearing for 22 Kittredge Street, DEP File #5-1480, 3-0.
Continued the hearing for 76 & 78 Paine Avenue, DEP File #5-1479, to September 15, 2026, 3-0.
Continued the enforcement matter for 11 & 13 Bay View Avenue to October 6, 2026.
Approved payment of Conservation Agent July mileage of $18.56 and Conservation Field Inspector July mileage of $28.27, 3-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 58 West Street, DEP File #5-1472, 3-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 343 Dodge Street, DEP File #5-1476, 3-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 31 Haskell Street, DEP File #5-1477, 3-0.
Issued an Order of Conditions for 22 Kittredge Street, DEP File #5-1480, 3-0.
Approved the meeting minutes of July 28, 2026, as presented, 3-0.
